evals.prompt: Use a tiled albedo map, normal map, roughness map, and HDR environment on a product model without incorrect color treatment or runaway GPU memory.
evals.expected_output: A texture plan that separates color/data maps, verifies UV channels and environment handling, and owns/reuses/disposes GPU texture resources deliberately.
assertions: Applies display color treatment only to visible color textures
Checks UV requirements and map semantics rather than guessing material values
Calls out texture dimensions, mipmaps, sharing, and disposal as memory concerns

evals.prompt: Our production GLB and KTX2 transcoder return 404 from the CDN.
evals.expected_output: Routes asset transport and decoder configuration to threejs-loaders.
assertions: Names threejs-loaders as the primary owner
Does not misdiagnose a network/decoder deployment error as a UV setting
